name: git
description: Git operations agents get wrong in ways that silently lose work — resolving merge, rebase and cherry-pick conflicts by both sides' intent, stashing safely when several worktrees or parallel agents share one clone, a hook that blocks unnamed stashes, unref'd pops, plain force-pushes and, where a project opts in, pushes to its protected branches, and /git:setup, which writes the project's git-workflow skill and .claude/git.json
